scope: One fixed complete native CPU task; no selector or general workload claim
environmentPolicy: Unchanged workflow.py per-task CPU/cgroup/SMT gates; abort on the first unqualified run, retain every started run, no retry or sample replacement.
cpuSelection: One 30-second idle observation; rank physical cores >=2 by the maximum mean load of their SMT threads, then CPU number; freeze one core before any task timings.
cachePolicy: Normal warmed executable/filesystem pages; no cache purge; independent native process and fresh output directory per task; cyclic positions are balanced twice.
inference: Paired bootstrap of ratio of arithmetic mean complete-task latencies; six primary comparisons use Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided intervals. A candidate must clear all three comparators and the resource and drift gates. Single-machine, single-input evidence only.
historicalBoundary: New prospective fixed-task experiment following user scope reduction. Prior failed discovery and unrun five-cell selector protocol remain unchanged. Case chosen for existing long-physics acceptance, without choosing a timing winner.
stop: One attempt, 15-minute child deadline, 1 GiB output budget plus 10 GiB disk reserve; no additional project or optimization pass automatically follows.
